scope: Occupation names transcribed from a user-provided List of Occupations pasted from Investigator Handbook. This transcription is user-supplied and has not been independently checked against the book. The list is not filtered to 1920s occupations; era tags and applicability require review. This is not an official complete list unless independently confirmed against the source edition.
